Build's clean now, exit 0. Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `retryCount`. That crashed with `Cannot read properties of undefined`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing `backoffEnabled` flag as an error instead of "off." The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`.

Both call sites now match what the bumped packages actually send. Build finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors — the warnings left are just the deprecation noise, nothing blocking.
